Es el día del amigo secreto, y todos tienen que escribir una carta para su mejor amigo y leerla en el salón. Nancy cree que la carta de Alan es para Sofi, pero se sorprende al darse cuenta de que es para ella.

Quique logra que le regresen la beca a Sofi, quien se siente profundamente agradecida. Por otra parte, Karla coloca un letrero de "se busca mesera" para sustituir a Sofi, encontrándose con que muchas de las chicas de la escuela aplican.
Eva, una mujer recién divorciada, tendrá que presentarse a los desafíos de criar a sus tres hijos, de su trabajo, su nuevo jefe y la joven novia de su exmarido.
Albertano decide mudarse a Lomas de Chacaltepec, un pueblo mágico donde su peculiar forma de ser lo mete en divertidos aprietos.
Gaby y Plutarco buscan independizarse y, para eso, comienzan a trabajar en un supermercado.
Nacaranda y Nacasia se comprometen a cuidar la perrita de una de sus proveedoras de catálogo, pero en un descuido la pierden.

Iván, biólogo investigador de la UNAM mexicano de 62 años, fue elegido por la ruleta de la suerte para concursar. Él y su esposa tienen el sueño de invertir en la investigación de un medicamento para contrarrestar el alzhéimer.

Two sisters search for a shared home in Maryland to accommodate themselves and their numerous pets; one sister desires a bright, practical space; the other prefers a dark and moody atmosphere.

Retta's journey to find scary begins with a road trip where four homes compete for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a creepy concrete home, a haunted observatory and a home that's too haunted to live in.

A cardiologist and mental health therapist couple are miles apart in their N.J. home search; he wants a factory loft while she prefers a suburban sanctuary, and with their budgets a million dollars apart, it may be a battle of style over substance.

Opposites attract as an accountant searching for homey vibes clashes with her frugal partner in Chicago; one doesn't want to leave the city's gay district, while the other craves high-rise glam to prove she's made it.

After banking a bundle on an impulse sale of their custom home in Warrenton, Ore., a couple's now stuck in his parents' basement; he's holding out for a massive indoor sports gym, but she's desperate for turnkey luxury in a tight market.

A single woman looks for a home in Dallas she can share with her mother that gives each of them their own space. She wants a place that's big and modern, but her mother prefers something more modest and traditional.

After five moves with the military, a family looks for a home with enough room for their kids and foster kids in Richmond, Virginia; she wants midcentury modern, but he's nostalgic for the early 2000s, millennial gray home he grew up in.

After living apart for six months, a woman's new career finally brings her husband to Pittsburgh in search of their new home; she wants a farmhouse near her job in the suburbs, but he wants a place with walkability in the city.

A San Diego couple is searching for a fresh start in New Jersey. He's pushing to buy an older, quirky home beside his aunt and uncle, but she refuses to settle for anything less than her modern fantasy.

LA sisters need a second home the whole gang can live in as they expand the family business to Charleston, South Carolina. One wants to be near the action in the city, but the other is hard-nosed and pregnant, and prefers a fancy house in the burbs.

A couple with three young boys relocates to Houston for his job, and they want to go big; he wants a large, traditional fixer he can renovate to his taste, but she's willing to spend on a fully-updated turnkey house they can move into with ease.

A 20-something buyer is moving straight from her parent's house to homeownership in Atlanta; she's willing to splurge on a condo in the city to make it her personal fairyland, but Mom's coming along to give her daughter a reality check.

Noel takes on a psychic medium and her husband, who are struggling to leave a home deeply tied to their family's history; a couple looks for a property that supports homeschooling their kids with flexible living spaces and acreage for a zip line.

Noel helps BMX legend Aaron Ross and his family search for a home that fits their bikes, memorabilia and active lifestyle; a throuple looks for a home that's built for three with spacious primary suites and plenty of gathering space.
Matthew, Joey and Keshia face a decades-old carpet, while Brian, Jodie and Beverley build an arch; also, ridiculous phone pranks only turn up the rivalry.

Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.
It's the 50th anniversary of one of British motoring's forgotten heroes, the Triumph Dolomite Sprint; so, Mike and Elvis have to get one.
Mike and Elvis take on a Porsche 911 in rough shape: it turns up in pieces on a trailer. If they can revive it, they'll take it on an epic drive through the Cairngorms.
Freiburger and Dave Chappelle road trip a derelict 1980 turbo Trans Am over 600 miles to a car show, with several transmission swaps along the way.

The Raunchero is taking its last road trip for now; Freiburger and Finnegan escort their 302-powered '68 Ford Ranchero on its final 1,100-mile journey, before it serves hard time at the Old Montana Prison & Auto Museum in Deer Lodge, Montana.
A man hopes that Chip and the A-Team can work their magic and give new life to his wife's 1962 Porsche 356.
Chip and the A-Team are called upon to give new life to a high-school automotive repair teacher's prized Sunbeam Tiger.
Chip and the A-Team step in when a man is unable to turn his beloved 1968 Mercury Cougar into the car of his dreams.
Metal magician Chip Foose is called upon to rescue a man's 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air from a state of disrepair.

Joe Martin is ready to upgrade a special car in his collection, a '60 Impala that's been collecting dust for nearly 25 years; Joe and the guys get to work, but with a new X-frame and engine comes a lot of problems.

Joe gets to work on upgrades to his '60 Impala with a new frame and engine; Mandi selects a '49 Buick to sell to fund the build, and Uncle Bill helps to get it sale-ready; it's time for Joe and Mandi to check out the updated ride with its new stance.

Danny and Penny Cobbs own an award-winning '55 big-window truck, but it doesn't run; they need Joe Martin to get this showstopper on the road; the team plans an engine swap and some other cool updates, including a killer, new set of wheels.

Mandi and Shag have a lead on a '70s step van, which Joe and the team will transform for a fan's whiskey business; the crew must find a new hood for a '54 Chrysler New Yorker wagon that matches the fit, paint and patina of the original.

Joe and the team continue transforming the '70s step van into a rolling billboard for a whiskey company; the body gets an extreme makeover; Joe works on the van's artwork; a local customer stops by for some help on his 1950 Chevy pickup truck.

There's a change of plans for the Whiskey Van; the owner wants to auction the van off at Mecum and donate the proceeds to St. Jude's Children's Hospital; Joe and Mandi are excited by the idea, but only have five months to finish the van for auction.

La Tierra se protege del Sol con varios escudos: uno generado por el núcleo planetario, otro por la atmósfera y un tercero por los sistemas climáticos; de no ser por ellos, la vida en la Tierra no se hubiese desarrollado.

La Tierra está viva. Aunque los componentes básicos de la vida son comunes en todo el universo, la vida es peculiar ¿Qué tiene el planeta Tierra que lo hace diferente? ¿Qué da la vida? Y si sucedió aquí, ¿podría suceder en otro lado?

La Tierra tiene que ser letal para que la vida prospere. La muerte está integrada en todo, desde las células hasta el planeta mismo, y las extinciones masivas crean oportunidades que la evolución aprovecha.

Janet and Herv have kept their hoarding a secret from everyone, but as they confront the clutter, shocking secrets concerning their relationship and sex lives are coming to light, leaving them in a fight to save their house and their marriage.
Cary's paralyzing obsession with Elvis memorabilia has left his New York City apartment virtually uninhabitable.
A woman hides a GPS in her child's car seat in order to track the child's father after he reportedly injures himself and cries domestic violence.
A landlord is accused of coming home from vacation early to try to catch his tenant violating pet policy; she accuses him of invasion of privacy.

A grown man complains that it was a hassle to borrow thousands of dollars from his aunt after he got out of prison; an uninsured motorist's attempt to reach for lip balm in her back seat while driving leads to a collision.
A man dramatically accuses his sister-in-law of murdering his sick mother and then expects his niece and nephew to embrace him as an uncle.

An entertainment manager accepts money from his girlfriend to promote a male model at a fashion show; a teen says a male co-worker made unwanted romantic advances toward him and harassed him incessantly over a small debt.
A newlywed sues a bridal-shop owner for delivering a reportedly damaged, custom-made wedding gown.
The plaintiff says he had a one-night stand with the defendant 20 years ago, and she ended up pregnant, but she claims that when she told him she was pregnant, he denied paternity.
A woman insists the defendant is her 16-year-old daughter's father, but he has doubts, so she petitioned the court for a paternity test to prove it.

Con la ayuda de Stella, Grisú debe cuidar y alimentar a un león marino bebé mientras Madame Naturella cuida de su madre. La cría es muy traviesa, así que deben evitar que llegue al mar y se pierda, pero la misión no es fácil.
Sam y Julia reciben una semilla de la madre de Julia, la cual, según cuenta la leyenda, da un fruto que inspira valentía.

Tres valientes héroes forman Cosmicrew: Storm el tigre, el carismático capitán, Flash el mono, rápido y bondadoso, y Rainbow el conejo, la mente inquieta. Juntos protegen la Tierra de las amenazas y aprenden a aceptarse a sí mismos y ser mejores.

En el futuro, los árboles reales han sido reemplazados por árboles sin rastrillos de alta tecnología de la marca Crock. Pero, ¿son estos increíbles árboles nuevos demasiado buenos para ser verdad? En una palabra, sí.

Elijah quiere aprender a silbar como un pájaro. Es el deseo que escribió en su libro de deseos y planea hacerlo realidad la noche de las estrellas fugaces. Sin embargo, Charlotte le dice que se pronostican nubes.
El señor Charlie se da cuenta de que un dron vuela a su alrededor con mucha frecuencia y quiere averiguar por qué.

En un encantador edificio, en una calle tranquila, en una gran ciudad, siempre se encuentran caras amistosas en las aventuras de unos pequeños vecinos que atesoran cada una de sus similitudes y diferencias.
En Tummy Tales, un grupo de niños observa un avión que hace un bucle en el aire. Los Teletubbies observan una estrella fugaz. La tostada Tubby Toast hace un bucle al salir volando de la tostadora.
Cuatro curiosos Teletubbies juegan juntos en Teletubby Land.
El granjero Haywire quiere preparar ocho panqueques para los gnomos, pero no sabe cuánto necesita de cada ingrediente. El Escuadrón Numérico acude al rescate.
Las aventuras de la pequeña hada Lu y sus amigos del bosque: la mariquita Bu, el caracol Ba, la polilla Gu y el grillo Ga.
Molang y Piu Piu ayudan a filmar una película en una isla perdida en el Pacífico. El actor es exigente con ellos.
El proyecto de Jade se pierde antes de que pueda enseñárselo al guardabosques Leopold. Los Mini Héroes no lo encuentran y Jade tiene que armarse de valor para decir la verdad.

Jackeline Cacho entrevista a los latinos que dejan su huella y se sienta a conversar con los integrantes de ese ejército de héroes que llevan consigo historias de lucha y perseverancia que los han llevado al éxito.

Un mundo donde la comida cobra vida en proporciones gigantescas. Cinco niños se embarcan en aventuras inolvidables llenas de diversión.

Jenny y Blam, su oso de peluche y mejor amigo, dirigen una tienda de magia en Dreamville, donde todos pueden acudir en busca de ayuda mágica dejando en la tienda todo lo que les impide vivir la vida y tomar decisiones.
Lili invita a Jasmine a jugar y está tan preocupada por su plan que se olvida de divertirse.
Rosie, una niña entusiasta, inteligente y positiva, con su pintoresco grupo de amigos, se embarca en un divertido viaje de descubrimientos para aprender valores importantes y lecciones de vida.
Lili no puede ir a Irán a visitar a su abuelo, así que la lleva a una aventura persa que jamás olvidará.
A Ciervo le falta alguien con quien jugar, pero aparecen los demás y empiezan a decorar el árbol para una fiesta.
Lu ordena con magia, pero al jugar crea más desorden. Pero después de que la varita falla, aprenden a limpiar solas.
El Capitán Rojo y el Escuadrón de los Números buscan la rara hierba dorada, descifrando pistas numéricas para localizarla.
